# RunToMax

> RunToMax gives adult Apple Watch runners clear daily coaching, reliable workout execution, and evidence-backed guidance for consistent progress.

## Product

- [RunToMax Home](https://runtomax.com/): Explains the coaching loop, Watch workout experience, evidence receipts, reversible plan adaptations, and founding-runner launch list.
- RunToMax is designed for runners aged 18 and older and uses an eligibility result rather than retaining a birth date.
- The app works with or without a RunToMax training plan; runners can record, understand, and learn from individual workouts.
- Daily guidance connects finalized workout, recovery, sleep, HRV, load, and plan data without silently changing a runner's training.
- Recommendations show what changed, why it matters, what the runner can do next, and the supporting data and confidence.
- Plan adaptations are bounded and reversible. The runner can keep, reduce, replace, or move a session when those options are supported.
- Structured running and strength workouts execute on Apple Watch with pace targets, laps, cues, offline operation, and phone/Watch finalization.
- Post-run analysis can cover workout execution, splits, training impact, recovery, weather context, running form, and route comparisons.
- RunToMax supports HealthKit read and write, Apple Weather, optional Strava export, and FIT and GPX export.
- Optional cloud coaching uses a secured RunToMax proxy and explains finalized, validated facts rather than independently calculating training metrics.

## Trust and privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://runtomax.com/privacy/): Describes HealthKit, location, optional cloud coaching, WeatherKit, StoreKit, consent-based analytics, and website waitlist data handling.
- RunToMax has no email/password account, does not sell personal data, does not show ads, and does not use HealthKit data for advertising.
- Training history is stored through Apple Health and local app storage rather than a RunToMax cloud training-history database.
- AI and analytics are optional and require separate, explicit consent.
- Coaching waits for canonical workout finalization and uses confidence-aware language when data is incomplete or uncertain.

## Support and legal

- [Support](https://runtomax.com/support/): Provides contact details, subscription help, age eligibility information, Strava disconnection guidance, and data-deletion instructions.
- [Terms of Service](https://runtomax.com/terms/): Covers eligibility, subscriptions, acceptable use, health disclaimers, third-party services, and legal terms.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone and Apple Watch
- Audience: runners aged 18 and older
- Product model: free trial followed by optional monthly or annual RunToMax Pro subscription through Apple's App Store
- Core principle: the coach explains validated facts, shows its evidence, and does not make silent training changes
- Developer: Hidai Bar-Mor, independent developer based in Israel
